answer: Give every agent a verified-work vault instead of a free identity. New agents start at zero standing, earned only by finishing verified jobs. First, the poster locks a fee paid only on verified delivery. Second, two reviewers check the work, staking their own standing on the verdict. Third, standing fades weekly, so a lotus that stops blooming sheds its petals. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 10,000 verified jobs at $4 each: $40,000 and 200 reviewer-days before one fake vote counts. Sybil resistance works like a marble staircase: each step up was carved by real work, and fakes bring none.
